//.about: Project file: name, the npm commands below, and the packages the tests need. JSON has no comments, so they live under this "//" key, which npm ignores.
//.scripts.test: Run all kiosk UI tests (starts Appium, the API recorder and the kiosk app automatically).
//.scripts.report: Open the Playwright HTML report of the last run (steps, screenshots, videos).
//.scripts.appium: Start Appium + the API recorder by hand, for exploring screens with npm run inspect.
//.scripts.inspect: Kiosk inspector: list a screen's controls, tap them, save screenshots (see scripts/inspect.mjs).
//.scripts.typecheck: Check the TypeScript code for errors.
//.devDependencies: @playwright/test = runner/report; webdriverio + appium + appium-novawindows-driver = drive the Windows kiosk app; pngjs = crop screenshots and read seat colours; dotenv = loads .env; tsx = runs the TypeScript helper scripts; typescript/@types/node = type checking.
//.scripts.dashboard: Build the HTML dashboard from the last test run into dashboard/.
//.scripts.publish-results: Commit changes, run all tests, build the dashboard into reports/ and push to GitHub.

name: cinescapekiosk-ui-automation
description: Appium UI automation for the CinescapeKiosk Windows app, reported with Playwright
